test_environment: Node.js MediaDevices, MediaStreamTrack and DOM fixtures

results.name: Enumerates video devices only without opening hardware
Saving and restoring a device works with no input signal and no stream
Opening uses exact saved ID and audio false; identity stays unverified
Missing device fails without falling back to the built-in camera
Permission denial and busy-device errors retain saved configuration
Permission enumeration always releases its temporary stream
Cancel during a pending device request discards and stops a late stream
Cancel permission request or close page releases late authorization tracks
Muted and ended tracks update state without claiming a verified signal
Device removal stops current tracks and retains the user's exact choice
Unexpected device identity and playback failure release tracks
Blocked or corrupt browser storage does not prevent current-page configuration
Latest enumeration wins and unsupported contexts never request capture
Destroyed active adapter releases every track and removes hotplug listeners
Device UI separates save from open and keeps unsaved choices from opening another source
